Fashion Show

Postponed – Spectacle Shop Spring Eyewear Show

Thu, May 14, 2020 · Spectacle Shoppe, Inc

When
Thu, May 14, 2020
Where
Spectacle Shoppe, Inc
2405 Hennepin Ave, Minneapolis, MN
Cost
Free

Due to the uncertainty of when government recommendations around gatherings will be lifted we are postponing this show.  Sign-up to our email list to get notified when this important local event and our other events happen.

Mark your calendar for our annual Spectacle Shop Spring Eyewear Show at the Uptown location. Featured designers and boutiques:

  • NSOD & Yessenya
  • Winsome Goods ( women )
  • Autum’s Vintage ( women )
  • MensWear Market (men)
  • Local Motion ( women )
  • Bittersweet Designs ( women )
  • Ayeado ( mens & women)

A special performance from Caroline Naomi

With over 12,000 frames in stock and Certified Opticians to serve you, come check out the Spectacle Shoppe and see why we are the most awarded optical in the Metro. We offer same day service with in house labs at our New Brighton, Grand Ave and Uptown locations. See for yourself why the Spectacle Shoppe far surpasses any big box optical store in the industry.
